Delivery has hovered at ~150 impressions/day for three days at a CPM near or above $170 — extraordinarily high, meaning the auction is barely serving the ad. With essentially no traffic reaching the page, zero leads is a volume outcome, not a page or offer verdict.

Hypotheses (ranked)

  1. Advantage+ is still in its learning phase (high). It was switched on only 08.27 (2 days ago); Meta typically needs several days and ~50 events to stabilize delivery. Low, expensive delivery early is expected.
  2. Budget floor vs. high CPM (medium). At ~$28/day and ~$180 CPM, the math caps delivery near ~150 impressions — too thin to exit learning quickly.
  3. Account/creative signal is weak (lower). With 0 lead history, Meta has little conversion signal to optimize toward, which can keep CPM elevated.

Recommended Action

One change: hold the Advantage+ switch and let it complete its learning phase — make no new change today. Stacking another change now would reset learning again and we'd never know what worked. Monitor delivery daily.

  • Decision point (~08.31-09.01): if impressions/CPM haven't improved after Advantage+ has had ~4-5 days, the single next lever is a budget increase to lift delivery above the starvation floor (creative refresh is the fallback after that).
  • Next constraint down-funnel: landing-page conversion — untestable until real traffic arrives.

Expected Result & Economics

Right now $28/day is buying ~150 impressions and 0 measurable outcomes. If Advantage+ exits learning, expect CPM to fall and impressions to rise, finally putting enough visitors on the page to read a CR against the 10% goal. Only then can lead economics be assessed.

Approval Needed

  • Needs sign-off (soon): budget increase if delivery hasn't improved by ~09.01.
